placement_finding_INSTRUMENT.what: shape_at_sky.py resolves the Siril-crop y-convention by trying 'bottom' first and accepting it when every box's median-star offset is within tol = box/2 * scale * 1.5 = 2.83 deg (~600 px). A wrong convention mirrors a box about the canvas centre row, displacing it by 2*(y0 - H/2); for any position set whose boxes ALL lie within ~300 px of the centre row that displacement is inside the tolerance, so the wrong convention verifies and ships displaced boxes. The check cannot fail on the defect it names for mid-row position sets.
